comments.author: RealMo3
comments.body_html:
yes, the reload animation is unaltered from the original. I was gonna ask Choccy about fixing the reload loop but I dont think he’s gonna be back around anytime soon, and I dont know much about bundles and animations tbh. And yes, “StackMaxSize:” are on lines 56, 385, 429, and 473.

Delete the mod.js after you edit the mod.ts, launch the server, and a new mod.js will be generated.

I am going to increase to 50 rounds next update, since that’s the average box size for these ammo types in stores and usually the batch number for estimating supplies needed when reloading your own.
